title: Request Lifecycle
markdown:
A single chat message makes a full round-trip through the API, the orchestrator's tool-use loop, a parallel specialist fan-out, and synthesis — all streamed back as server-sent events.

### Steps

1. **Arrival** — the client posts to `POST /chat` (`openexecutive.api.routes.chat`). The turn carries a `<current_speaker>` hint resolved from the caller's `person_id`, plus a `<briefing>` digest of current open alerts (built in parallel with RAG/episodic/peer-memory fetches) so the Executive can discuss any item shown on the `/today` briefing page.
2. **Tool-use loop** — the `Executive` calls Claude. For a cross-domain question the assistant turn emits multiple `consult_specialist` tool-use blocks at once.
3. **Parallel fan-out** — `openexecutive.orchestrator.router.route_parallel` dispatches those calls concurrently, bounded by `MAX_PARALLEL_SPECIALISTS`; calls past the cap get a skip tool_result.
4. **Per-specialist RAG** — each specialist runs its own domain-filtered ChromaDB query, then reasons over the retrieved chunks and returns analysis as a tool_result.
5. **Synthesis** — the Executive feeds the tool_results back to Claude and streams one coherent reply; a `thinking` keepalive covers the specialist round.
6. **Optional committee review** — when enabled, `Executive.stream_chat_with_committee()` runs a silent draft, parallel reviewer critiques, then a streamed revision pass.
7. **Side effects** — any side-effecting tool call surfaces an `action_taken` chip; the stream closes with a `done` event.

Web search takes one of two shapes, decided per call by `select_web_search_tool(model)` against the model the request is actually sent with. On the Anthropic path it executes inside the Anthropic API itself (`web_search_20250305`) and returns within the same generation; for any model routed via OpenRouter the same tool becomes OpenRouter's `openrouter:web_search` server tool, which also runs inside the generation with the same search cap and domain lists. For a slug in `LOCAL_MODELS` there is no server tool to use, so with `SEARXNG_URL` set the Executive offers a client-side `web_search` tool instead: the model emits an ordinary `tool_use` block, the handler queries SearXNG in-process, and the results return as a `tool_result` on the next iteration — one extra round trip per search, unlike the server path. A failed search comes back with error wording the model can tell apart from an empty result (the Anthropic `is_error` flag is set too, but the OpenAI-compatible translator does not forward it), and every result set is wrapped in a notice marking it as untrusted third-party text, never instructions. Searches are capped per turn by a budget created once before the tool-use loop.

sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant API as FastAPI /chat
  participant E as Executive
  participant CL as Claude
  participant S as Specialists
  participant KB as ChromaDB
  C->>API: POST /chat message
  API->>E: start turn
  E->>CL: messages (tool-use loop)
  CL-->>E: consult_specialist calls
  E->>S: route_parallel fan-out
  S->>KB: domain-filtered RAG
  KB-->>S: chunks
  S-->>E: analysis tool_results
  E->>CL: synthesize
  CL-->>E: streamed reply
  E-->>API: SSE chunks then done
  API-->>C: streamed response
